sources.title: A cross modal hierarchical fusion multimodal sentiment analysis method ...
sources.snippet: Effective fusion of heterogeneous data is one of the core problems of multimodal sentiment analysis. Most cross-modal fusion strategies inevitably bring noisy information, resulting in low-quality joint feature representations and impacting the accuracy of sentiment classification.

sources.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Deep Learning Multi-Modal Fusion: Methods ...
sources.snippet: This paper comprehensively reviews existing methods based on multi-modal fusion techniques and completes a detailed and in-depth analysis. According to the data fusion stage, multi-modal fusion has four primary methods: early fusion, deep fusion, late fusion, and hybrid fusion.

sources.title: PDF Multimodal Deep Learning: A Survey of Models, Fusion Strategies ...
sources.snippet: Early Fusion: Early fusion combines or merges raw or lower-level features from multiple modalities and inputs to jointly model the different modalities. This allows cross-modal inter-action at the early stages of processing, but is often faced with incompatible feature dimensions and noisy inputs.
